title: map-framework-mapped.json
description: Phase 3c output: every framework objective mapped to service controls or marked N/A. Produced by map-framework-mapping skill. Consumed by map-assemble. Every entry in framework_mapping[] MUST carry objective_id, domain, title, status, coverage, reason, controls[]. status MUST be exactly 'MAPPED' or 'N/A' (iter-14 Class F15-revised).

framework_header_canonical.description: Canonical framework-header string (iter-14 Class F12). map-assemble.py emits this into mapping-results; every generated artifact copies it verbatim.

status.description: 'MAPPED' (a confident, cited mapping), 'N/A' (not applicable), or 'UNCERTAIN' (the mapper believes there is a relationship but cannot produce a concrete citation — surfaced for review, excluded from coverage %, never silently asserted or dropped). No 'UNMAPPED'/'NOT_APPLICABLE'/'n/a' variants.

review_reason.description: Required on an UNCERTAIN row: why the mapper could not produce a concrete citation (what linkage is missing).

citation.description: Optional per-objective citation naming the evidence for the mapping (may also live per-control). objective_requirement + source make it concrete.

mitre_techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ids resolved from the AWS Threat Model source for the mapped controls.

mitigation_refs.description: AWS Threat Model mitigation references (alias + uuid) the mapping cites.

coverage.description: Preferred values: 'Fully Covered', 'Partially Covered', 'Supportive Only', 'N/A'. Legacy values (FULL, PARTIAL, SUPPORTS, NONE) accepted for backward compatibility with archived runs.

applicability_justification.description: Required to override an N/A-by-default domain (DCS/UEM/BCR/IPY, TVM vuln-metric objectives) to MAPPED. One sentence on why the service genuinely supports this objective. Enforced by validate_domain_applicability.py.

reference_url.description: Public AWS doc URL backing an applicability_justification when an N/A-by-default domain objective is overridden to MAPPED.

coverage_level.description: Preferred values: 'Full Coverage', 'Partial Coverage', 'Supportive'. Legacy values (High, Medium, Low) accepted for backward compatibility with archived runs.

citation.description: Evidence for this control's mapping: the specific objective sub-requirement satisfied + its source (threat_model | assessment_gap | aws_doc), optionally the mitigation alias/uuid and MITRE techniques. Presence of objective_requirement + source is what makes a MAPPED row a confident (non-UNCERTAIN) mapping.
